description: Ammonia refrigeration of coolers, freezers, and docks at 8 plants and 4 DCs; temperature monitoring and alerting for cold storage CCPs and 380 refrigerated trailers
process_owner: Director of Refrigeration and Process Safety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Temperature abuse begins within hours; cold storage is a CCP in every plant's HACCP plans (9 CFR 417.2(c)(4)); about $240 million of refrigerated and frozen inventory sits at the 12 sites on a typical day
source_evidence: EV-074 (Director of Refrigeration and Process Safety interview); EV-053 (inventory value at the 12 sites); EV-067 (cold-chain coverage); EV-025 (manual log exercises)
manual_workaround: Refrigeration runs on local controllers if monitoring is lost; hourly manual thermometer logs (procedure exercised at only 3 of 12 sites); move product to shore-powered trailers
dependent_third_parties: Cold-chain monitoring vendor; refrigeration contractors; electric utilities; generator fuel suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Refrigeration technicians; warehouse staff; engine rooms at 12 sites
quantified_impact_basis: About 4% of refrigerated inventory held, evaluated, and partly destroyed if monitoring is lost across sites for 24 hours with incomplete manual logs
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 has no cellular backup for its sensor gateway
single_points_of_failure: One cold-chain monitoring vendor for all 12 sites and the trailer fleet

description: Smokehouse and oven cook cycles and chilling for bacon, hams, sausage, hot dogs, deli meats, and fully cooked entrees at 8 plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product in a cycle when control is lost must be held and evaluated as an unforeseen deviation (9 CFR 417.3(b)); lethality and stabilization records are required before release
source_evidence: EV-074 (COO interview); EV-052 (revenue per production day); EV-026 (historian and chart recorder settings)
manual_workaround: Smokehouse controllers finish stored cycles locally; chart recorders on 22 of 64 smokehouses; manual probe readings every 30 minutes
quantified_impact_basis: About 60% of daily production value ($18.8 million) passes through a thermal CCP
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 historian has no audit trail and no restore test

description: Central recipe release from the MES and automated brine and cure (sodium nitrite) dosing at the plants
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cured and injected products cannot be made without verified formulations; a wrong nitrite level is a chemical hazard; formulations change rarely so the last approved release is the recovery point
source_evidence: EV-074 (SVP FSQA interview); EV-007 (signed formulation masters); EV-021 (MES DR test 2026-05-16)
manual_workaround: Plant MES edge servers keep the last 72 hours of approved recipes; hand-weighed cure batches from signed formulation masters with second-person check
quantified_impact_basis: Cured and injected products are about 35% of daily production value
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 formulations are still in its legacy recipe system
single_points_of_failure: Central MES (single instance, one region with warm standby)

business_process: Processing, packaging, labeling, and lot coding
description: Grinding, stuffing, injection, slicing, packaging, metal detection and X-ray, checkweighing, labels and lot codes at 8 plants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lines stop without MES label and lot data; mislabeling risks misbranding and allergen recalls (9 CFR 418); about $18.8 million of production per day
source_evidence: EV-074 (COO interview); EV-052 (revenue per production day); EV-025 (manual labeling exercises)
manual_workaround: Pre-printed label stock with manual lot codes and second-person check; inspection devices run standalone
dependent_third_parties: Label and film suppliers; AI vision vendor
quantified_impact_basis: All production stops if labeling and lot coding stop across plants
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 labels print from its legacy recipe system

business_process: Prepared foods and plant-based production at PLT-07
description: Fully cooked entrees and meatballs (FSIS) and plant-based protein products (FDA) at PLT-07
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Food defense monitoring and preventive controls records are required for the plant-based room (21 CFR 121.140; 117.305); about $1.4 million of production per day
source_evidence: EV-074 (PLT-07 Plant Manager interview); EV-052 (production value by plant); EV-058 (food defense plan)
manual_workaround: Pause plant-based intake; manual monitoring forms for food defense and preventive controls; hold product
single_points_of_failure: Shared CIP system and refrigeration between the meat and plant-based rooms

business_process: Food safety records and pre-shipment review
description: Electronic HACCP, Sanitation SOP, food defense, and preventive controls records; pre-shipment review; records for FSIS and FDA review
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product may not ship until records show critical limits were met (9 CFR 417.5(c)); records must be available for official review (417.5(f); 21 CFR 121.320)
source_evidence: EV-074 (SVP FSQA interview); EV-027 (records platform and pre-shipment review); EV-053 (shipment volume)
manual_workaround: Paper CCP forms and paper pre-shipment review; hold finished product
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; records platform software vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Plant QA technicians; plant FSQA managers
quantified_impact_basis: About 80% of daily shipments wait for pre-shipment review; holds create cold storage congestion and late deliveries
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 uses a legacy local eHACCP application

description: Lot genealogy from receiving to customer shipment; recall execution under 9 CFR 418.3
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FSIS notification within 24 hours if adulterated or misbranded product entered commerce (9 CFR 418.2); during an active recall the MTD drops to 4 hours
source_evidence: EV-074 (SVP FSQA interview); EV-056 (mock recall results); EV-072 (traceability platform)
manual_workaround: Daily traceability export to a controlled offline copy; paper shipping records from the WMS
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; ERP and WMS vendors
quantified_impact_basis: Recall labor and scope expansion if lots cannot be traced quickly; regulatory and safety impact dominates
acquired_plant_dependency: PLT-08 lot data reaches the platform by nightly batch

description: Order intake from about 300 customer accounts through EDI and the customer service team; order release to plants and DCs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: National grocery and foodservice delivery windows; missed deliveries lead to chargebacks, fines, and lost shelf space
source_evidence: EV-075 (Vice President, Distribution and Transportation interview); EV-053 (orders through EDI); EV-052 (sales value)
manual_workaround: Order intake by email and phone from the top 50 customers; last EDI export; manual order release
quantified_impact_basis: Chargebacks, lost sales, and expedited freight at about 22% of daily sales value

description: Receiving, putaway, picking, and loading at DC-01 to DC-04
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer delivery windows; refrigerated dock time limits
source_evidence: EV-075 (Vice President, Distribution and Transportation interview); EV-053 (DC volumes); EV-052 (sales value)
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists from the last WMS export; handwritten bills of lading
quantified_impact_basis: Missed shipments from the 4 DCs at about 27% of daily sales value

description: Routing, dispatch, and trailer temperature telematics for 260 tractors and 380 trailers; for-hire carriers for about 35% of loads
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loads can wait about a day; trailer temperature records travel with the load
source_evidence: EV-075 (Vice President, Distribution and Transportation interview); EV-053 (fleet and for-hire carrier share); EV-067 (trailer telematics)
manual_workaround: Paper dispatch sheets; driver phone check-ins; trailer recorder downloads
dependent_third_parties: TMS vendor; telematics carrier; for-hire carriers

description: Purchasing and receiving of carcasses, primals, ingredients, and packaging; receiving temperature checks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Suppliers can hold loads for about a day; inbound product must be checked and refrigerated on arrival
source_evidence: EV-074 (COO interview); EV-053 (raw material on hand; packer share)
manual_workaround: Paper receiving logs and handheld thermometers; phone orders to the top suppliers
dependent_third_parties: Meat packers (top 3 supply about 70% of primals); ingredient and packaging suppliers

business_process: SL-1 cold storage and logistics services
description: Refrigerated storage, handling, and transport for about 40 food company customers; customer portal with inventory, temperature history, and lot data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer contracts commit to portal availability and to temperature records; customers rely on the records for their own food safety programs
source_evidence: EV-075 (Vice President, Distribution and Transportation interview); EV-047 (SL-1 customer agreements); EV-052 (SL-1 revenue); EV-076 (portal failover observation)
manual_workaround: Email reports of inventory and temperatures from the last export; phone customer service
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; cold-chain monitoring vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About $440,000 of daily SL-1 revenue plus contract credits

business_process: SL-2 co-manufacturing and private label services
description: Production to customer specifications at 4 plants; customer portal for orders, specifications, CCP record packages, and certificates of analysis
process_owner: Vice President, Co-Manufacturing and Private Label
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers accept short portal outages; production follows BP-02 to BP-04; customer specifications are confidential
source_evidence: EV-075 (Vice President, Co-Manufacturing and Private Label interview); EV-047 (SL-2 customer agreements); EV-052 (SL-2 revenue)
manual_workaround: Email record packages; phone order changes
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.7 million of daily SL-2 revenue at risk of delay

description: Weekly payroll for hourly plant and DC staff and biweekly payroll for salaried staff (about $12.7 million a week); SOX-relevant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cutoff 72 hours before pay date; state wage payment laws; workforce retention
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll with adjustments through the payroll provider
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties, overtime corrections, and turnover risk

description: Quarterly and annual close, SOX controls, 10-Q and 10-K preparation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines at quarter-end (MTD drops to 48 hours during the close window); SOX IT general controls
source_evidence: EV-075 (CFO and Controller interviews); EV-033 (SEC filer status)
manual_workaround: Extend close calendar; manual journal entries with dual approval
quantified_impact_basis: Late filing risk dominates; direct cost is small

description: Gift box orders, consumer accounts, and consumer complaints line
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 1% of revenue; consumer complaints may signal food safety issues and must still be received
source_evidence: EV-075 (Controller interview); EV-052 (online store share of revenue); EV-065 (consumer accounts)
manual_workaround: Consumer complaints by phone; pause online orders

description: Sausage and marinated meats at the acquired Texas plant, still on its legacy directory, network, recipe system, and eHACCP application
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same food safety drivers as BP-02 to BP-04; legacy servers back up nightly (actual RPO 24 hours) and the legacy support contract states a 24-hour restore
source_evidence: EV-074 (Vice President, Integration Management Office interview); EV-055 (PLT-08 integration status); EV-020 (PLT-08 nightly backups); EV-077 (PLT-08 support contract)
manual_workaround: Paper CCP forms; pre-printed labels; hand-weighed batches
dependent_systems: Legacy directory; legacy recipe system; legacy eHACCP; SYS-01; SYS-02 at PLT-08
dependent_third_parties: Local IT support firm; controls integrator (VPN without MFA)
single_points_of_failure: Legacy directory and local IT support firm
